facts.text: The resort is a private island located 5 kilometers off Ream National Park in the Gulf of Thailand in southern Cambodia.
facts.excerpt: The private island resort in Cambodia is located 3 miles (5 kilometers) off Ream National Park in the Gulf of Thailand in southern Cambodia

facts.text: All accommodation is in private free-standing pool villas that blend into the canopy of trees.
facts.excerpt: private free-standing pool villas that blend into the lush canopy of trees

facts.text: The villas have green living roofs and make maximum use of daylight.
facts.excerpt: with green living roofs and maximum use of light during the day

facts.text: The villas follow the Sleep With Six Senses standard.
facts.excerpt: the groundbreaking Sleep With Six Senses standard for a good night’s sleep

facts.text: The spa offers traditional Khmer massage and Cambodian healing treatments.
facts.excerpt: De-stress with a traditional Khmer massage or dive deeper into our signature spa menu and Cambodian healing treatments.

facts.text: Spa design and treatments are inspired by the sacred Kbal Spean River.
facts.excerpt: Spa design and treatments inspired by the sacred Kbal Spean River

facts.text: Tree Restaurant serves a modern twist on traditional Khmer cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Head to Tree Restaurant for a modern twist on traditional Khmer cuisine

facts.text: Through sustainable planning the resort blends into the natural vegetation, which has become a haven for birds and butterflies.
facts.excerpt: our resort in Cambodia blends into the natural vegetation, creating an environment that has become a paradise for birds and butterflies

facts.text: Experiences range from action-packed adventures to leisurely pursuits.
